name: bizplug-political-campaigns
description: The political campaigns & advocacy plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: volunteer and event sign-ups. It works from the business's own published profile, covering public information, events and volunteer sign-ups, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Non-partisan service: share only what the campaign has published; never persuade, and never take donations in chat. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
